name: Ashe
identity: ember knight in brass-edged steel plate; ONE sword in the RIGHT hand; ONE barred-visor helm with a crimson crest, carried under the LEFT arm and worn only in Cinderhelm; crimson cape and tabard
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/ashe.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Banked Fire
techniques.effect: Heat builds in the blade; Ember thrust spends it for extra power.

fx: heat glow on the fuller, 5 steps

upgrade.name: Banked Fire II
upgrade.effect: At full heat the guard costs less.

techniques.name: Shoulder Check
techniques.binding: lower Armoured guard within 0.5 s after it blocks a hit
techniques.effect: She drives the pauldron forward in a short shove.

upgrade.name: Shoulder Check II
upgrade.effect: The check breaks a tank's shield guard.

techniques.name: Ember Wake
techniques.effect: The thrust leaves a short burning line on the ground.

upgrade.name: Ember Wake II
upgrade.effect: Cinderhelm's closing finisher also leaves the wake.

techniques.note: adds an effect to Codex's natural-expiry finisher without changing its damage; needs C60's OK (#149)
